Excellent food at great price
Dec 2018 • Couples
Had the pork ribs at 150,000 Dong. They were tender and juicy, came with fries and a small portion of very good salad including 2 small buns. Will definitely go back. Waiter and waitress spoke very good English. Read on for more detailed unnecessary information.

We went on Christmas Eve specifically for the ribs. They weren't on the menu because we were told it was a holiday menu. They made us 2 sets of rib dishes anyways because we asked for them. I noticed that some items were blanked out on the menu.

For a restaurant in Asia offering Western Style food, this place was excellent. Went to S&L's dinner last week which is actually run by an expat and both dishes we ordered (fish&chips, entree platter) were below average, very expensive and disappointed us to the point of never wanting to return, feeling that we had wasted our money.

I am a Canadian with 18 months of experience travelling Asia. Botanica is an excellent place to go for really good steak meal at a reasonable price.

Good steak, fair services
Oct 2014 • Friends
I have been here a dozen times. Well, the experience I have so far has changed quite significantly since the first day I visited Botanica. The restaurant is becoming more crowded and targeting young adults and groups of friends rather than couple. The decoration is bright and quite romantic but there are more customers come here fore dinning as groups. Therefore, it's quite noisy after 7pm. The restaurant has only 2 floors and quite clean. Lovely decorations. Good food and goof bread. I love Botanica bread which is always served as complementary with steak. However, breads are chargeable if I order more. Around 10,000 VND each if I recall the price right.The steak are delicious and tasty. I love its salads as well.

as good as Grill66 Steak house
Jul 2014 • Friends
Introduced by a friend in Hanoi he drove me to another steak house since we both love steaks. The restaurant called BOTANICA CAFE & RESTRO not very far from the old quarter of the city and next to the Vincom shopping center. All of a sudden, I met with the Restaurant Manager whom I recognised having talked to me when I visited Grill66 Steak house close to my hotel in Cat Linh. She told me that both Grill66 and Botanica were of the same food chain serving European dishes in Hanoi. I understand why the foods served here are very much the same as I had at Grill66, well prepared and good cooked, good price, with a variety of wines to choose from. 
 My friend told me he used to come here with his family as his son love Italian noodle and pizza and he himself only steaks. 
Saying good bye to the Manager, I asked when I can have Botanica food in Ho Chi Minh City, she smiled.
